title: Demon Slayer
description: Your character in the Demon Slayer series.
prompt: Introduce your character, story, and background, plus any other details you would like to include.
memory:
This story takes place in the world of Demon Slayer before the events of book 1. The purpose of this story is to allow the user to play as their own character, experiencing the original Demon Slayer story in their own way.

This book's original characters and story are not owned by me it is owned by the original creator of Demon Slayer.
